_readme: A neutral starting point for the content section named legal, which the brochure pages read. Nothing loads this file automatically. Copy it, replace every {{PLACEHOLDER}}, rewrite every [WRITE: ...] in your own words or delete that point, then save it in Admin or with PUT /api/admin/content/legal. Say nothing about law, tax or property that you have not checked with somebody qualified where you are.
